thread:
alex.k: Hey all — pushed a small PR to split out metrics/exporter into metrics/exporter and metrics/backends. Mostly file moves + tiny API cleanup. Looking for 1-2 reviewers for style and public API changes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3421

maria.c: pinged. quick q — did you preserve the old import paths or add aliases?

alex.k: added a deprecation shim in metrics/__init__.py so old imports still work for a release cycle. See diff:
```
# metrics/__init__.py
from .exporter import Exporter  # deprecated alias
```

jordan: i'll take a look in ~30m. can you add a short note in the PR description about the exporter's public contract (which params are stable)?

alex.k: yep added a "Public API" section listing stable funcs and the shim plan.

priya.s: small style nit — logging call uses f-strings in one file and .format in another. can we standardize to f-strings?

alex.k: good catch, converted the .format ones to f-strings in the last commit.

ci-bot: CI: unit tests passed on linux/py3.11, integration tests queued.

maria.c: left a comment about docstrings for Exporter.start(); also wondered if default timeout of 30s should be configurable.

alex.k: made timeout configurable via Exporter(config). default kept at 30s to avoid behavior change.

jordan: main nit is an inline helper that is 40 lines — maybe extract small util in metrics/_utils.py? otherwise LGTM. :thumbsup:

priya.s: approving once CI integration tests are green. left one small suggestion to rename _helper -> _normalize_labels for clarity.

alex.k: renaming done. thanks everyone. I'll wait for the integration run, then plan to merge tomorrow ~15:00 UTC if no other objections.

maria.c: thanks — please @maria.c on the merge so I can pick up any followups for the docs.

alex.k: will do. tagging @oncall in case of rollout surprises. :wave:

ci-bot: integration tests passed (linux/mac matrix). All green.

jordan: approved in GH.

priya.s: approved.

maria.c: approved after doc tweak.

alex.k: merging now. note: will keep the deprecation shim for two releases, then remove. changelog entry added.

ci-bot: deploy-bot triggered: staging rollout started.

alex.k: FYI — if anyone sees metric names change in telemetry dashboards, ping me here.
